versions.content: Target address for generic connection transmission If the Dcm is about to send a response, response on event, or periodic message for a generic connection request, the Dcm shall set TARGET_ADDRESS_16 to the value of the stored source address in the MetaDataPtr in the PduR_DcmTransmit().
